Acenstream.shortDescription: Web application to manage dynamic content on a remote TV

ComparUtil.shortDescription: School project : Mobile app for comparing products through surveys.
ComparUtil.description: School project done in the 2nd year of Bachelor degree : Mobile survey app that compares multiple products with each other. Users answer predefined questions by selecting options. At the end, products are ranked based on the points they received.
ComparUtil.details: Full-stack developer on the project, working as part of a team of 4 developers and a project mentor.

ComparUtil.more: First React-Native experience (the old one with class components), PHP and database management with SQL requests.
